page_summary: This page discusses cybersecurity standards and frameworks relevant to ports, asking respondents if they follow any specific guidelines. It also outlines priorities for cybersecurity over the next 12 months, including improving threat detection, enhancing technology security, and compliance with regulations. Additionally, it addresses perceived barriers to advancing cybersecurity in ports, such as lack of funding and expertise. Finally, it inquires about role models or best practice ports in cybersecurity.
